_doc: Entity names a bq_standard:hunt task may target, and dimensions a location task may use. BQ matches a hunt target against EntityList.stringToClassMapping and never checks it at load, so a wrong name fails silently. Each name was read from the mod's own registration code in the jar (see 'how'); 'summon' records the runtime check: '/summon <name>' in a server trial resolves the name through the same map BQ uses. Add a name here only after checking it the same way.

TwilightForest.Naga.how: TFCreatures.registerTFCreature -> registerModEntity; creatureCompatibility is never set, so no global name

TwilightForest.Twilight Lich.how: registerModEntity. Shadow clones are the same class but take no damage (attackEntityFrom returns false), so they cannot be killed for credit

TwilightForest.Minoshroom.how: registerModEntity; extends EntityTFMinotaur, so target the Minoshroom, never the Minotaur

TwilightForest.Hydra.how: registerModEntity. Multi-part: head and body parts pass the player's DamageSource to superAttackFrom, and onDeath calls super, so the kill is credited

TwilightForest.Tower Boss.how: registerModEntity; the Ur-Ghast. It extends EntityTFTowerGhast, so never target 'Tower Ghast' for the boss

HardcoreEnderExpansion.Dragon.how: chylex.hee.init.EntityList -> registerModEntity 'Dragon'. Multi-part: attackEntityFromPart ends in EntityLiving.attackEntityFrom with the original source

Mobzilla.how: registerGlobalEntityID first, so the plain name is the EntityList name. MobzillaHead passes the player's DamageSource to the body

The King.how: registerGlobalEntityID; KingHead relays the player's DamageSource to TheKing.attackEntityFrom

The Queen.how: registerGlobalEntityID; QueenHead relays the same way

demonmobs.rahovart.how: MobInfo.registerMob -> registerModEntity under the demonmobs group mod; lang key entity.demonmobs.rahovart.name

TragicMC.OverlordCore.how: TragicEntities: registerModEntity + EntityList.addMapping 'TragicMC.OverlordCore'. The last of three phases (Cocoon -> Combat -> Core); a Synapse Core block placed in the Synapse summons it again (BlockSynapseCore)

MutantCreatures.MutantZombie.how: registerModEntity only; drops the Hulk Hammer
